name: @taste-and-see/nest-observability
description: Shared OpenTelemetry observability plumbing for Taste & See Nest services. Exports ObservabilityModule.forRoot({ serviceName, httpMetrics? }) — wires the Prometheus /metrics scrape endpoint + the global HttpMetricsInterceptor (meter name derived from serviceName) — and createObservabilityBootstrap(serviceName) (importable via the `/bootstrap` subpath, free of any @nestjs/core dependency so it can run as main.ts's first-line side effect before auto-instrumentation patches Nest). Lifts the verbatim copies that lived in every service's src/observability/. TS-022-followup-3a-followup-1.
